result.prior_version_note: Under the original Ord. 25-057 (adopted May 21, 2025; approved by the Mayor May 22, 2025), § 218-12(2)(a) made it unlawful for a real estate lessor, agent or subcontractor to 'subscribe to, contract with, or otherwise exchange anything of value in return for the services of a Service Provider.' Ord. 25-076 (adopted July 16, 2025; approved July 17, 2025) added 'or otherwise utilize' the services of a Service Provider. Neither ordinance states an effective date. The June 2025 in-force month comes only from a secondary law-firm summary (DX06) and gives no exact day.
